# Refinancing Ballarat Guide

Independent editorial guide on refinancing home loans in Ballarat, Victoria, Australia. Published by Home Loan Broker Ballarat.

## Topic

## What this page covers

## Key facts
- Brokers compare 40-plus lenders; process typically free to the borrower
- Switching costs commonly $700 to $1,500 for a variable-rate refinance
- Break-even on savings typically 6 to 18 months on a $400,000+ loan
- Ballarat median house price sits in the mid-$500,000s (2026)
- Settlement timeline: 3 to 6 weeks from application
